description: This file contains classes and functions related to building and installing platform-specific packages, including abstract base classes, package management, and platform info retrieval.

classes.name: PackageBase
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a build package on the filesystem.

classes.name: Packager
classes.description: Top-level class for building platform-specific packages.

methods.name: _ImportModule
methods.description: Converts a filepath to a Python import path and imports the module.

methods.name: _GetPackageClass
methods.description: Loads the package class associated with a given platform.

methods.name: _GetPlatformInfosDict
methods.description: Finds starboard ports supporting package building and returns a dict of platform names to classes.

methods.name: PackageBase.__init__
methods.description: Initializes source and output directories for a package.

methods.name: PackageBase.Install
methods.description: Abstract method to install the package to targets.

methods.name: PackageBase.ExtractArguments
methods.description: Extracts arguments from options for package construction.

methods.name: Packager.SupportedPlatforms
methods.description: Returns list of platforms supported for packaging.

methods.name: Packager.GetPlatformInfo
methods.description: Retrieves info for a specific platform.

methods.name: Packager.BuildPackage
methods.description: Builds a package for a specified platform.
